newsitem.title: GERMANY: TV spoof raises fears of Bonn holiday tax.
newsitem.headline: TV spoof raises fears of Bonn holiday tax.

text.p: Many Germans seem to believe that not even their beloved summer holiday journeys abroad are sacred from the long reach of Finance Minister Theo Waigel, struggling to plug holes in his budget with new taxes.

Thousands of worried viewers flooded the WDR television station with angry calls on Thursday evening after the Monitor programme ran a satire claiming Waigel planned a tax of 150 marks ($86) on Germans leaving the country on holiday.

"Some viewers were really concerned because they believe the government is capable of even the most absurd measures to improve the current tax situation," said Monitor editor Klaus Bednarz of the spoof report. ($ = 1.751 German Marks)
